parsed.rationale: All 15 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type, spread across six unrelated packages (WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, app:iOS) and covering entirely distinct domain concerns: glass-effect compatibility, overlay sheets, blend modes, gesture handling, accent-color environments, HUD views, share-extension views, playcut rows, and status-bar styling. The structural signal is purely a name collision on the implicit `View` extension target — there is no shared field list, no shared ancestor, and no Jaccard similarity reported (`jaccard: null`, `shared_field_count: null`). Consolidating these extensions would couple unrelated packages and violate the single-responsibility boundaries that motivated the per-package split in the first place.
